scope: Structured companion to docs/REFERENCES.md and the selected Preskill source in website/learning_bridge.json. Imported ingredients, related-work comparisons, and educational background remain distinct. This bibliography is not a comprehensive literature or priority audit.

metadata_verification.scope: Identifiers, titles, and author lists checked against the official arXiv abstract or versioned HTML pages recorded for each entry. The channel identification in EXT2, the dephrasure rate-versus-threshold comparison, and the entanglement-assisted reliability distinction received focused source checks. No publication venue or publication-year field has been inferred.

entries.title: The private classical capacity and quantum capacity of a quantum channel
entries.role: Coherent-information coding theorem: a chosen finite block with positive coherent information gives a positive asymptotic unassisted quantum rate.
distinctions: The finite inner block is fixed before the asymptotic outer coding argument.
This use does not supply an efficient decoder or high-fidelity recovery from the inner repetition block alone.

entries.title: Positivity and nonadditivity of quantum capacities using generalized erasure channels
entries.role: Generalized/incomplete erasure framework. Equation (35) yields the present receiver channel when the auxiliary channel is the noisy classical measurement map and the intact probability is 1-p.
distinctions: The channel class and direct-sum structure are established prior work.
The present contribution is a full-span sufficient guarantee under its specified common-error model.

entries.title: Dephrasure channel and superadditivity of coherent information
entries.role: Weighted repetition construction and its positivity-threshold behavior, as identified by Equation (15) and Appendix F in the canonical comparison.
distinctions: Repetition coding and coherent-information superadditivity are established ingredients.
The dephrasure output structure differs from the present receiver channel.

entries.title: Capacities of Quantum Erasure Channels
entries.role: Erasure-channel capacity, used together with EXT5 for the completely random reporting endpoint Q = Q^(1) = max(0, 1-2p).
distinctions: The reporting-noise endpoint is treated separately from the interior entropy certificate.
This endpoint formula is not an exact capacity formula for the interior common-error channel.

entries.title: The quantum capacity is properly defined without encodings
entries.role: Quantum-capacity converse and erasure-channel coherent-information evaluation, used with EXT4 for the completely random reporting endpoint.
distinctions: The joint canonical endpoint conclusion is Q = Q^(1) = max(0, 1-2p).
The endpoint converse does not replace the separate proof for interior reporting error.

entries.title: Bounds on Information Combining With Quantum Side Information
entries.role: Adjacent literature on entropy comparisons with quantum side information.
distinctions: The project's specific polynomial inequality has its own certificate.
This related-work citation is not a substitute for that certificate or its independent verification.

entries.title: Improving quantum communication rates with permutation-invariant codes
entries.role: Permutation-invariant-code comparison: the cited dephrasure results improve communication rates without demonstrating an extension of the weighted-repetition positivity threshold.
distinctions: A rate improvement and a positivity-threshold improvement are different claims.
The comparison with neural-network codes is a separate benchmark.
The preserved source S6, section 4, incorrectly describes this result as a threshold improvement; docs/REFERENCES.md#s6-correction supplies the canonical correction.
source_locators: Source S6, section 4, with the canonical correction

entries.title: Superadditivity for Entanglement-Assisted Communication
entries.role: Adjacent superadditivity result for entanglement-assisted communication reliability.
distinctions: Entanglement-assisted reliability differs from the unassisted quantum-capacity guarantee proved here.
Its reliability enhancement does not make the entanglement-assisted capacity nonadditive.

entries.title: Quantum Shannon Theory
entries.role: The single educational anchor: coherent information, decoupling, repetition inner codes, and unassisted quantum-coding achievability. The project supplies the channel-specific geometry and entropy comparison.
distinctions: Preskill's Q_1 corresponds to optimized one-use coherent information, not operational finite-error one-shot capacity.
His depolarizing-channel p and capacity-definition accuracy parameters are not this project's measurement probability p and physical reporting error epsilon.
Textbook foundations do not establish the project's full-span inequality or certify its numerical proof input.
The source is linked for personal use; its PDF, extracts, screenshots, and textbook figures are not redistributed.
